title: The Space Between Moments – Fragments
meta: Medium: Single-channel generative video with sound
statement:
When does one self become another?

I don’t think it ever finishes.

Fragments explores the space between moments through a single presence in constant flux. A face becomes recognizable, then dissolves into overlapping features and shifting states of self.

Six recurring facial forms move through a fixed sequence, emerging in moments of clarity and breaking into pixelated fragments. Their layered features suggest a self that can never be held entirely still.

A band of color moves across the eyes, quietly marking passage within the recurring sequence.

Fragments approaches the question ' what happens in the space between one moment and the next? ' through the human face.

Perhaps we are always more fragments than we realize.
